summary: The diff implements all six requirements for the Leave Application Generator: manual generation mode (REQ-1), always-visible output buttons (REQ-2), Clear Output functionality (REQ-3), date picker fix (REQ-4), RTL/language consistency (REQ-5), and PDF optimization (REQ-6). Evidence is present across LeaveApplicationPage.tsx, leaveApplicationLetterTemplate.ts, and leaveApplicationPdfExport.ts. Some details are truncated but the key structures are clearly implemented.
